en.title: yding-git/personal-edge-proxy: Multi-inbound/outbound personal proxy setup with Xray & Hysteria2
en.hook: A practical personal edge proxy system combining Xray, Hysteria2, REALITY Vision, and Cloudflare WARP.
key_takeaways: Integrates modern proxy protocols including Xray, Hysteria2, and REALITY Vision
Supports flexible outbound traffic routing via Cloudflare WARP and static SOCKS5
Enables a customizable multi-inbound and multi-outbound network setup for edge proxies
